title: Reasons before power: a first reading edition
purpose: An ongoing work of inquiry, writing and construction; coherent releases remain open to revision, growth and deliberate reduction.
scope: Source-first reading edition with Love in DelayBasinese, four complete dated philosophical essays, prior workshop essays, Field Notes collaboration essay and evidence companion; no private planning corpus. Adds the art-door visit essay; no private room contents or credentials. Adds the evolving Aigents project sketchbook; ordinary public reflections only.
change: Two explicit reading doors and a compact, foldable Unicode Dashboard. Revision details recede into provenance; observation disclosure is The Listening Window within the Dashboard. Accepted writing, dashboard data and RSS unchanged.
